description_en: Queries the list of connection configurations
kebab_example: aliyun eventbridge list-connections --connection-name-prefix connection-name --type Http --max-results 10 --next-token 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListConnections

parameters.help_en: The name prefix of the connection configurations to query. Supports prefix matching
parameters.help_zh: 获取指定连接配置名称的参数，支持前缀匹配查询
parameters.name: connection_name_prefix

parameters.help_en: Filters query results by connection type. Valid values: Http, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch. If left empty, connections of all types are returned
parameters.help_zh: 按连接类型过滤查询结果。可选值：Http、MySQL、PostgreSQL、Elasticsearch。不传则返回所有类型
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Can be used together with NextToken to implement pagination.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
限定每次返回的最大条数，可以和nextToken搭配使用实现翻页能力。

默认值是10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
When MaxResults is specified, NextToken is returned if there are more results to fetch.

NextToken starts from 0 by default. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
当指定MaxResults时，如果还有多余的返回值则会返回NextToken。

NextToken值默认是从0开始计算的，默认值是0
parameters.name: next_token
